creator: bengusberg
title: Five Claude skills/tools to stop AI-looking websites: awesome-design (DESIGN.md), Taste skill, Impeccable, Emil Kowalski design skill, Playwright

tools.name: awesome-design / getdesign.md
tools.detail: 'A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.' -- getdesign.md/

tools.name: Taste Skill
tools.detail: tasteskill.dev -- 'gives your AI good taste. stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop'; pulls inspiration from real websites

tools.name: Impeccable
tools.detail: teaches Claude clean visual design (impeccable.style per other videos)

tools.name: Emil Kowasaki design skill
tools.detail: named 'Emil Kawasaki' in captions; described as particularly good at animations (likely Emil Kowalski, animation/design educator)

tools.name: Playwright
tools.detail: playwright.dev -- 'framework for Web Testing and Automation... Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API'; connect to Claude so it drives the browser to test designs

claims: AI website tells: beige background, 'the AI font', italicized word for emphasis
awesome-design lets you 'steal' design systems from the world's best brands for free
Playwright lets Claude take over your browser to test the site actually works
how_to_steps: Drop a DESIGN.md from the awesome-design collection (getdesign.md) into your project
Install the Taste skill so Claude references real sites for inspiration
Install the Impeccable skill for clean visual design
Install the Emil Kowalski design skill for animations
Connect Claude to Playwright (MCP) so it can open the browser and verify the design
on_screen_only: Hook card: 'AI BUILT YOUR WEBSITE IN 10 MINUTES. SO DID YOUR COMPETITOR'S.'
GitHub 'About' panels: getdesign.md/ ; tasteskill.dev ; playwright.dev with their descriptions
cta: Follow for more on AI, founder life, and leadership

relevance.why: Directly addresses the 'looks AI-built' problem for a founder shipping apps with Claude Code; the skills are drop-in and the Playwright loop is a workflow upgrade, not just aesthetics.

implement_score.why: Low effort: add a DESIGN.md, install one or two design skills (Impeccable/Taste) and the Playwright MCP. Pick one design skill to avoid conflicting instructions; measure whether output actually improves.

verify: Confirm getdesign.md, tasteskill.dev and impeccable.style exist, their GitHub repos, licenses and maintenance
